name: assetpanda/integration-directory
title: AP Integration Directory
description: Integrations hub directory: eyebrow, H2 with a gradient slice and lede over a Categories radio list (left; a scrollable chip row on tablets and phones), a search field and a paginated three-column grid of logo cards (logo, name as the card link, indigo category tag, three-line description, Learn More row), with Previous / numbered pages / Next under it. Every card is server-rendered; behaviour.js adds the category filter, debounced live search over name, tag and description, 12-per-page pagination, an aria-live result count, the empty state, a card-shuffle animation on every filter, search or page change (Web Animations on transform/opacity; instant under reduced motion) and ?category= / ?q= in the address bar. Without JS every card shows. Figma: Desktop - Integrations > Features Section (7310:158798). This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
